notes: litert-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B: qwen3_30b_a3b_mixed_int4_ekv2048.litertlm, a LiteRT-LM conversion of Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B at revision ad44e777 (Apache-2.0), Qwen's mixture-of-experts model (48 layers of 128 SiLU experts, 8 per token; thinking on by default), text in, text out; written with the LiteRT Tensor API (LiteRT dcb657e8 with a small patch in the conversion scripts): each layer's experts one TFLite custom op moe with SiLU and int4 blockwise-32 weights, attention and lm_head int8 per channel, fp32 activations declared, KV cache 2,048 tokens; packed with litert-lm-builder 0.19.0; LiteRT-LM's own Qwen3 metadata verbatim, the checkpoint's tokenizer.json byte for byte. The moe op with SiLU is in two open LiteRT pull requests (#11192 GPU, #11188 XNNPACK); LiteRT-LM 0.19.0 from PyPI refuses it on both backends, as these two records show; the numbers of the LiteRT-LM built from source with LiteRT #11192 and #11188 (the repo card's Performance and Accuracy tables) are not records: that build has no frame here. Mac Studio rows only: the file is 20.65 GB and no phone was tried. Landed 2026-11-09: litert-community/Qwen3-30B-A3B is public and ungated (license apache-2.0, base_model Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B quantized, library_name litert-lm), upload commits d307ec5a (KV 4,096) and c81095a8 (KV 2,048) of 2026-11-03, main f12ad63fa3 (2026-11-03T10:44:18.000Z) at the read; the tree's LFS oid and size of qwen3_30b_a3b_mixed_int4_ekv2048.litertlm = artifact_sha256 and 20650316480 B.
quantization: decoder written with the LiteRT Tensor API from the bf16 checkpoint: each layer's 128 experts in one custom op moe with int4 blockwise-32 weights (fp32 block scales, floored at 2^-14; the form LiteRT #11309's quantizer writes for this op, made with ai-edge-quantizer 0.10.0's functions), attention q / k / v / o and the output layer int8 per channel, router, norms and token table fp32; declared fp32 activations; fp32 KV cache of 2,048 tokens; signatures prefill_128, prefill_1024 and decode
